_provenance.purpose: Grounded alias table so an Economy extinction pass (energy-extinction.js pattern) does not falsely retire activations. activeTriggers is built from pulse condition-codes (e.g. gdp_decline) + active diagnosis ids (e.g. RECESSION) (energy-telemetry-adapter.js L48-53 pattern). This table bridges the pulse-engine condition vocabulary to the issue circuit nodes and their free-text diagnosticTriggers.
_provenance.derivationChain: condition-code --(economy-pulse-engine.js inline classify, L186-241)--> evidence family --(EVIDENCE_CONTRACTS requiredFamilies, OR-semantics, L54-122 / L253-259)--> diagnosis id --(economy.json issues[]._authored circuit; adapter uses is._authored||is.circuits)--> circuit nodeIds --(each nodeId is an activation with FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers)--> diagnosticTriggers.
_provenance.foldRule: A diagnosis is folded into a condition-code only when the condition emits an evidence family that appears in that diagnosis requiredFamilies (matching the actual code gate at L253-259, which loops requiredFamilies with OR-semantics, NOT primaryIndicators). The link tag records whether the SAME token is also listed as a primaryIndicator or secondaryConfirmation of that contract, but folding is gated strictly on requiredFamily membership.
_provenance.discipline: No link invented. Conditions with no defensible chain are under unmapped. Trigger strings copied verbatim from economy.json; extinction matching is case-insensitive (energy-extinction.js L22,L29).
_provenance.heterogeneityVsEnergyAndFinance: MIXED lineage. (1) LIKE FINANCE: Economy inlines classification (economy-pulse-engine.js classifies conditions to families inline, no separate exogenous-event vocabulary) and its condition-codes ARE the contract indicator tokens (gdp_decline, sticky_cpi). (2) LIKE ENERGY, UNLIKE FINANCE: Economy activation.diagnosticTriggers are FREE-TEXT phrases ('GDP contraction', 'Yield curve inversion'), NOT diagnosis ids. So the diagnoses map here is NOT redundant self-matching (as it was in Finance) — the condition->diagnosis->circuitNode->freeTextTrigger expansion is the real, load-bearing bridge, exactly like Energy. (3) CLEANER PARTITION than Finance: Economy's six evidence-family pairs are disjoint (demand/labor->RECESSION, inflation/price->HYPERINFLATION, credit/banking->BANKING_CRISIS, trade/policy->TRADE_WAR, debt/fiscal->DEBT_CRISIS, market/asset->MARKET_CRASH), so EVERY condition-code links to exactly ONE diagnosis — no cross-linked conditions (Finance had shared market_event fan-out). (4) SAME AS FINANCE: macro_shock->macro_event is a dead-end (no contract consumes macro_event); _stress_* conditions are skipped (L190-191) and emit no family. (5) SAME AS FINANCE: MARKET_CRASH is the one catchAllBlocked:false diagnosis (the systemic catch-all). (6) Orphan count: Energy 1, Finance 3, Economy 3.

This alias lists exactly those brainNodeIds and their activations' FREE-TEXT diagnosticTriggers. conditionCodes.reason: economy-pulse-engine.js classifies macro_shock -> evidence family [macro_event] (L238-240), but NO EVIDENCE_CONTRACT lists macro_event in requiredFamilies (L54-122). The family is a dead-end: it reaches no diagnosis, hence no _authored circuit, hence no activation. NOTE: macro_shock IS listed as a MARKET_CRASH secondaryConfirmation token (L116), but MARKET_CRASH.requiredFamilies are [market_event, asset_event] (L113) and the requiredFamily OR-gate (L253-259) never consults secondaryConfirmation, so macro_shock cannot gate MARKET_CRASH. No grounded alias. (Same dead-end shape as Finance macro_shock/macro_event.)

economy-pulse-engine.js explicitly SKIPS any condition whose name starts with _stress_ (L190-191: continue before any family assignment). These dynamically-generated stress tokens emit no evidence family and are named in no contract, so there is no defensible condition->diagnosis link. The one catch-all-eligible diagnosis (MARKET_CRASH, catchAllBlocked:false) is reached by a diagnosis being externally marked active without evidence (L262-263), NOT by any _stress_ condition-code, so no alias can be grounded here. (Same exclusion as Finance _stress_*.)
